sim_id.description: ID of the Sequence or Evaulation to execute

schedule_run_now_selector.description: Selects whether the job should be run immediately or scheduled

schedule_job_datetime.description: If the job is scheduled, this indicates what time it should start.  Must be a string of format `YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM UTC`

repeat_job_selector.description: Optional.  If this job should be repeating then this param should a string equal to "on"

repeat_job_period_number.description: This param is ignored if the job is not repeating but it's required if repeat_job_selector == "on".  It indicates the time interval to repeat the job.

repeat_job_period_type.description: This param is ignored if the job is not repeating but it's required if repeat_job_selector == "on".  It indicates how the repeat_job_period_number should be interpreted as a time.  For example if repeat_job_period_number is 5 and repeat_job_period_type is "minutes", the job created will repeat every 5 minutes.

repeat_job_times_selector.description: This param is ignored if the job is not repeating.  If the job is repeating, it indicates whether it should repeat a fixed number of times, or indefinitely

repeat_job_count.description: If the job is repeating and repeat_job_times_selector is "number", then this param indicates how many times the job should repeat. For example, if this param is 3 then the job will run 4 times total - once for the initial run and then 3 repeats.

attack_node_id_1.description: ID of the attack actor for the first step in the sequence/eval.  If the sequence/eval specified by the sim_id param has more than one step, then the attack and target actors would be selected with attack_node_id_X and target_node_X params, where X is the order of the step in the sequence/eval, starting from 1.

target_node_id_1.description: ID of the target actor for the first step in the sequence/eval.  For sequences/evals with more than on step, the subsequent steps follow the same pattern of target_node_id_X as the attack_node_id_X

repeat_job_period_number_1.description: If the this job step should not repeat, then omit this param or leave it blank.  Otherwise, it works like the repeat_job_period_type param but for the specific step in the simulation.  Just like with the attack_node_X and target_node_X params, if a simulation has more than a single step then you can set the repeating attributes for each step by substituting the step order for X in the param name.

repeat_job_period_type_1.description: Works like the repeat_job_period_type param, but for the specific step in the simulation.

repeat_job_times_selector_1.description: Works like the repeat_job_times_selector param, but for the specific step in the simulation.

repeat_job_count_1.description: Works like the repeat_job_count param, but for the specific step in the simulation.
